definition: Design and sale of semiconductor memory products used for data storage and high-speed data access.
included_products_services: DRAM; NAND flash; NOR flash; high-bandwidth memory; embedded memory products when sold as memory components
excluded_products_services: Logic semiconductors; analog chips; microprocessors; GPUs; semiconductor equipment; outsourced foundry services; storage systems assembled from memory components
substitutes: Hard disk drives; cloud storage capacity; alternative non-volatile memory technologies
primary_demand_driver: Data center capacity growth; consumer electronics unit demand; enterprise storage and AI workload memory intensity
geographic_scope: Global, with demand concentrated in data centers, consumer electronics, PCs, smartphones, and industrial electronics
source: TASKS-2.md; client market-definition examples; analyst-defined v0 boundary review
notes: Narrower than broad semiconductor grouping; diversified chipmakers may require exposure weighting in later tasks

definition: Equipment and process tools used by semiconductor manufacturers to fabricate, inspect, test, and package chips.
included_products_services: Lithography tools; deposition equipment; etch tools; process control and metrology equipment; wafer inspection tools; ion implantation; semiconductor test and packaging equipment
excluded_products_services: Semiconductor devices; electronic components; general industrial machinery; cleanroom construction; raw silicon wafers and specialty chemicals unless sold as process equipment inputs
substitutes: Used semiconductor equipment; outsourced foundry capacity; process redesign that lowers tool intensity
primary_demand_driver: Semiconductor capital expenditures; process node transitions; fab construction and utilization
geographic_scope: Global, with demand tied to semiconductor fabs in Asia, North America, and Europe
source: TASKS-2.md; client market-definition examples; analyst-defined v0 boundary review
notes: Boundary is clearer for tool OEMs than for diversified industrial suppliers with small semiconductor exposure

definition: Ocean transportation of containerized freight on scheduled liner networks.
included_products_services: Container vessel operations; liner shipping services; container freight transport between ports; ocean container capacity sold to shippers and freight forwarders
excluded_products_services: Bulk shipping; tanker shipping; air freight; trucking; rail intermodal services outside ocean legs; ports and terminal operations; freight forwarding without vessel operation
substitutes: Air freight; rail and truck intermodal transport; regional short-sea shipping; inventory repositioning
primary_demand_driver: Global goods trade volumes; containerized import/export demand; retailer and manufacturer inventory cycles
geographic_scope: Global ocean trade lanes, with route economics varying by lane
source: TASKS-2.md; client market-definition examples; analyst-defined v0 boundary review
notes: Integrated logistics firms should be assigned only when vessel-operating liner exposure is material

definition: Manufacture and sale of tires for consumer, commercial, and specialty vehicle applications.
included_products_services: Passenger vehicle tires; light truck tires; commercial truck and bus tires; off-road tires; replacement tires; original-equipment tires
excluded_products_services: Rubber chemicals; synthetic rubber feedstocks; auto parts other than tires; tire retailing without manufacturing; wheels; vehicle manufacturing
substitutes: Retreaded tires; public transit or mobility alternatives; lower-mileage driving behavior
primary_demand_driver: Vehicle miles traveled; vehicle production; replacement cycles; fleet activity
geographic_scope: Global, with local replacement demand and regional manufacturing footprints
source: TASKS-2.md; client market-definition examples; analyst-defined v0 boundary review
notes: Retained as a client-priority example; local cluster support is limited because GT appears as the only clear Tires and Rubber row

definition: Production and sale of flat steel products used in sheet, plate, automotive, appliance, energy, and construction applications.
included_products_services: Hot-rolled sheet; cold-rolled sheet; coated sheet; galvanized sheet; steel plate; tinplate; electrical steel when sold as flat product
excluded_products_services: Rebar; structural beams; merchant bar; steel pipe and tube as separate fabricated products; iron ore mining; steel distribution without production
substitutes: Aluminum sheet; plastics and composites; imported flat steel; downstream fabricated metal products
primary_demand_driver: Automotive production; construction activity; appliance demand; energy and industrial capital spending
geographic_scope: Primarily regional because freight, tariffs, and trade policy shape delivered steel economics
source: TASKS-2.md; client market-definition examples; analyst-defined v0 boundary review
notes: Integrated steel producers may span flat, long, and raw-material exposure; later assignment should flag mixed product portfolios

definition: Production and sale of long steel products used primarily in construction and infrastructure.
included_products_services: Rebar; reinforcing bar; structural beams; sections; merchant bar; wire rod when sold into construction long-products markets
excluded_products_services: Flat-rolled sheet and plate; specialty stainless or alloy products unless sold as construction long products; steel distribution without production; fabricated building products
substitutes: Concrete alternatives; engineered wood; imported long steel; prefabricated construction systems
primary_demand_driver: Nonresidential construction; infrastructure spending; public works; reinforcing demand in concrete construction
geographic_scope: Primarily regional because freight costs, scrap supply, and trade policy affect market boundaries
source: TASKS-2.md; client market-definition examples; analyst-defined v0 boundary review
notes: Boundary separates long construction steel from flat steel even when producers operate both businesses

market_name: Oil and Gas Exploration and Production
definition: Upstream exploration, development, and production of crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids.
included_products_services: Oil and gas reserve exploration; drilling and development operated by E&P companies; crude oil production; natural gas production; natural gas liquids production
excluded_products_services: Oilfield services; contract drilling; midstream pipelines; refining; marketing; petrochemicals; integrated downstream operations
substitutes: Renewable power; energy efficiency; coal or nuclear generation in power markets; imported hydrocarbons
primary_demand_driver: Commodity oil and natural gas prices; reserve replacement economics; industrial, transport, heating, and power demand
geographic_scope: Global commodity market, with asset economics determined by basin and fiscal regime
source: TASKS-2.md; client market-definition examples; analyst-defined v0 boundary review
notes: Integrated majors should be treated as mixed-exposure cases in later tasks rather than pure E&P firms
